$$

$$

where $ m = \left\lfloor \frac{n}{10} \right\rfloor $ and $ k = n \mod 10 $.

To express this as a recurrence relation, we can define:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
n & \text{if } n < 10 \\
0 & \text{if } n \mod 10 = 0 \\

\left\lfloor \frac{n}{10} \right\rfloor & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$
